title: Dynamic Welfare-Maximizing Pooled Testing
abstract: arXiv:2601.22419v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pooled testing uses one test to certify several agents as healthy when the pooled result is negative. We study a budget-constrained welfare problem in which agents have heterogeneous utilities and independent prior probabilities of being healthy. Welfare is earned when an agent is certified healthy, and a dynamic policy may choose each pool after observing earlier test outcomes. We ask how much such adaptation can improve over a static allocation that fixes all pools in advance.   Our main result proves that the optimal dynamic policy has value at most twice that of the optimal static overlapping allocation, for every population, test budget, and pool-size cap. The proof samples a path through the dynamic policy using an independent health profile, randomly thins the selected pools, and compares the resulting static allocation with the dynamic policy one agent at a time. A Boolean-cube argument proves the comparison on uniform

translated_title: 动态福利最大化的混样检测
translated_abstract: 混样检测利用一次检测，在混合样本结果为阴性时同时证明多个个体为健康。我们研究一个受预算约束的福利最大化问题，其中各个体具有异质效用和相互独立的健康先验概率。当某个体的健康状况得到认证时即产生福利，而动态策略可以在观察先前检测结果之后再决定每个混合池的构成。我们研究这种自适应能力相对于预先固定所有混合池的静态分配能够带来多大改进。我们的主要结果表明：对于任意群体、检测预算和混合池规模上限，最优动态策略的价值至多是最优静态重叠分配的两倍。证明过程通过独立的健康状态样本来对动态策略的执行路径进行采样，随机稀疏化所选的混合池，并逐个个体地将所得的静态分配与动态策略进行比较。一个布尔立方体论证证明了在均匀（情形下的该比较结论）。
tldr: 本文证明在预算约束下的混样检测福利最大化问题中，自适应的动态策略相比最优静态重叠池分配的价值提升至多不超过两倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that for budget-constrained welfare-maximizing pooled testing, the optimal adaptive dynamic policy is worth at most twice the optimal static overlapping pool allocation, for any population, test budget, and pool-size cap.
